data.one_liner: Utility library containing shared type declarations for chat UI and core libraries.
data.what_it_does: Provides data classes, models, and JSON serialization for chat messages, rooms, and users. It is designed to be a shared dependency for chat-related packages rather than used directly.
use_when: You are building or using packages like flutter_chat_ui or flutter_firebase_chat_core that depend on these types.
avoid_when: You want to use it directly in your own app code without utilizing dependent chat UI or core packages.
You are building a custom chat system from scratch without flyerhq chat libraries.
strengths: Provides standardized chat data models out of the box.
Includes JSON serialization and copyWith methods for chat entities.
weaknesses: Not meant to be used directly as a standalone utility package.
Very narrow and specific domain scope.
